# Kitchener Heating & Cooling

> Licensed, insured HVAC company in Kitchener, Ontario. A full-service heating and cooling team handling furnace and AC repair, heat pumps, ductless systems, thermostats, and duct cleaning, plus seasonal maintenance, for homeowners across Kitchener and Waterloo Region. Call (519) 590-5333.
